name: Veil Masquerade #10
description: A cloth figure for Veil: a crowned mask over layered, patterned cloth falling to an uneven hem. Crown: Antlers. Aperture: Slot. Ornament: Diamonds and dots. Palette: Gold. Hem: Pointed. Its hem is shared with 2 others in the set of 20. No face — where the cloth is open, it is cloth removed rather than features drawn on.
